name: Ichinose Senri
source:
Though he has a pretty face, Senri is negative and reticent young man. Since he was brought up being treated cruelly by the people around him, he is distrustful of people and is poor at social interaction.

This hasn't changed since going aboard the Norn, as Senri hardly uses the common room; preferring to remain closed up in his own room.

His route is only accessible when the player selects Koharu as the protagonist.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.otomate.jp/norn9/vita/chara/?page=senri]official website profile[/URL]]
